questions.question: What aspect of nature did Elihu describe to show God's majesty?
options: The sea and its waves alone
The mountains and their high peaks
The vast deserts and their burning sands

questions.question: What did Elihu conclude about understanding God?
options: The Almighty is beyond our finding out, great in power and justice
Only the priests are able to know the secret ways of God
The wonders of all of nature surely prove that God does not even exist
God can be fully grasped by a wise and very patient mind
questions.answer: The Almighty is beyond our finding out, great in power and justice
